The '''Council of Agricultural Corps Masters''' was a [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] that oversaw the internal affairs of the [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]]. Answering to the [[Council of Reassignment/Legends|Council of Reassignment]] and working closely with the [[Republic Agricultural Administration]], this Council was one of few in the Order to allow members to be anything but a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. The ranks of the Council consisted of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] and simple [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who did not ascend past the rank of [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], like Jedi [[Gal-Stod Slagistrough]]. Predominantly, membership of the Council almost always consisted of at least one [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] or [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] Master.<ref name="TJP" />
